EI.bothE: You're both energized by talking things through out loud, so conversation between you tends to feel easy, fast-moving, and comfortable to jump straight into.
EI.bothI: You both prefer to think before speaking, so conversation between you tends to feel calm and unhurried, with room to consider before responding.
EI.E_with_I: You may feel like you have to work a little to draw them out, or that they're harder to read in the moment. Give them a beat to gather their thoughts rather than filling every pause yourself.
EI.I_with_E: You may feel swept along, or a little rushed to respond before you've fully formed your thought. It's fine to ask for a moment before jumping in.

TF.bothT: You're both comfortable with direct, logical feedback, so conversation between you tends to feel efficient and unfiltered, without needing to soften the message.
TF.bothF: You're both attentive to tone and impact, so conversation between you tends to feel warm and considerate, with real care taken not to bruise feelings.
TF.T_with_F: You may feel like they're reading more into your tone than you intended, or taking something personally that was only meant as information. A little more warmth in how you phrase things goes a long way.
TF.F_with_T: You may feel their feedback lands a bit blunt or cold, even when it isn't meant unkindly. It can help to ask directly whether something was meant as criticism or just a fact.
